text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooooooah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's Victoire Pisa!
She's claimed the first crown...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, but they were all seriously strong!
Now I'm way too hyped for the Japanese Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Fufu, that's a relief.

Among such a high-level lineup,
she brilliantly won the first race of the Classic Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, by all means.
Fufu, I'm looking forward to it."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. But before that, would it be alright
if you waited for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um...
We must carry out an "effective method."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone was so strong!"
"Can't wait for the Nippon Derby"...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh...!! Must be nice...
Everyone's getting praised so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're right, it's the Satsuki Sho after all――
Getting praised, getting recognized... Ahh, ahh!!
Dammit, I might as well just retire right now!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...About the Satsuki Sho...
...Your thoughts—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...? Are they talking outside the room... in the hallway?
Wait, is that voice... Rose?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What the hell, dammit...!
Are you just basking in the afterglow or something?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Something was decisively lacking today.
Don't you agree?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It was a heated battle, but...
it somehow felt a bit lacking, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Making a move that completely turns the tables in the endgame... If she were here, there would have been that kind of tension.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That vague sense of something missing—
it was tied to the overall enthusiasm of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you win the Nippon Derby without her,
can you truly say you've reached the pinnacle of this generation?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What!?
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoaâ

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“—No. This race made me intensely
conscious of a presence that cannot be left out.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We need you,
Rulership-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...! Gaaahh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Yo.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well done in the Satsuki Sho.
I watched your valiant efforts on the screen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Naturally, it was for research heading into the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, is that so.
Turns out it was totally unfounded worry.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: It looks like we're headed for the greatest Nippon Derby yet.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, indeed...! I am the master of the board who turns this into an exhilarating game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"So... well,
about that joint training session."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If you really wish for it, I wouldn't be
entirely opposed to putting together a schedule right now.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, glad you're quick on the uptake.
Let's head over there for our meeting right away—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Just as planned" sounds a bit manipulative, but...
it seems she's regained her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It certainly was a "more effective method"âwasn't it?
When she returned and met back up with me, she explained what had happened, looking unusually excited.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
you all seem to have gotten so close.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"When I try to solve someone's problems,
I have a habit of wanting to stay close by their side."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Still, the two of you supported Ruler in ways I never would have thought of..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The wheel was indeed turning on its own.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure the 'Japanese Derby'
will turn out to be truly wonderful."
Considering the outcome of the Satsuki Sho, public expectations for the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) rose even higher.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: As long as I am with all of you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Surely we can weave an even bigger circle...!

I nod firmly.
The sight of the wildly excited crowd flashes through my mind.

At the very center of all their pouring gazes—
it has to be Victoire Pisa!
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory—right into the center of the spotlight!
I will guide you to victory—right to the center of the circle!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes!
I'm in your care...!

"The Japanese Derby—
The crown of the generation's strongest will surely be hers."
